description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Title', which is responsible for creating and rendering a title in a graph, including setting text, font, alignment, and output positioning.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Title
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering a title in a graph, managing text, font, alignment, and positioning.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Title
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the title with text and font options.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text to be displayed as the title.

methods.name: _getAutoSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the automatic size of the title based on font and text height.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the title.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the title text at the calculated position, handling font and alignment.
